environment.description: Application deployed in EKS pod with AWS CloudHSM Classic cluster (firmware v3.4.4+). HSM partition configured with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 policy where CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE and CKA_NEVER_EXTRACTABLE=TRUE on all symmetric key objects. The PKCS#11 provider is the only registered JCE provider (no SunJCE fallback). Pod seccomp profile restricts ptrace/process_vm_readv syscalls. SQS queue has a resource policy requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID condition and messages must pass a Lambda-based content validator (schema enforcement) before reaching the consumer queue via SNS fan-out with filter policy requiring 'encrypted' attribute presence. CloudWatch alarm triggers circuit breaker on >3 NPE exceptions in 60s window.

config.circuit_breaker: CloudWatch alarm on NPE count > 3 in 60s
